summary: ICP (Motoko + React) starter app with Internet Identity authentication, role-based authorization (admin access control), and a simple product catalog frontend including admin product management pages and generated brand assets.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication (frontend hooks + login UI)
existing_features.description: Frontend integrates Internet Identity via hooks and a login button to create an authenticated identity for canister calls.

existing_features.title: Backend role-based authorization (access control + authorization mixin)
existing_features.description: Motoko backend includes authorization mixin and access-control logic to gate privileged operations (e.g., admin-only actions).

existing_features.title: Admin route guarding in the frontend
existing_features.description: Frontend adds an admin route guard and an Access Denied screen to prevent non-admin users from accessing admin pages.

existing_features.title: Product catalog frontend pages
existing_features.description: Frontend includes Home, Category, and Product Details pages with reusable components (e.g., ProductCard) and site layout/header/footer.

existing_features.title: Admin products management page
existing_features.description: Frontend includes an admin products page and supporting hooks for querying/admin product workflows.

existing_features.title: Profile setup modal and basic client-side storage utility
existing_features.description: Includes UI for profile setup and a storage utility used by the frontend for persisting local state/preferences.

existing_features.title: Build template and tooling for ICP deploy + image processing
existing_features.description: Adds build-template project scaffolding (Dockerfile, deploy scripts, canister configs) and scripts to resize/prune images.

existing_features.title: Add a concise “How to add products” help section to the top of the /admin Product Management page that explains the exact steps an admin should take (login, open Admin/Manage Products, click “Add Product”, fill required fields, save), and clearly lists required fields (Product Name, Category, Description, Image URL, Affiliate URL) vs optional fields (Brand, Price).

Improve admin navigation labeling so admins can more easily find where to add products by renaming the header nav item currently labeled “Admin” to “Manage Products” (still routing to /admin) in both desktop and mobile navigation.

When a category page has no products and the current user is an admin, add a secondary call-to-action in the empty state (e.g., a button) that navigates directly to /admin to add the first product for that category.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add/enable an admin workflow for adding new products to the catalog (create product UI and/or guidance for using the existing admin products management page).

architectural_notes: Frontend uses React + Vite with shared hooks for Internet Identity and canister actor creation.
Backend uses Motoko authorization/access-control modules to enforce admin-only actions.
Build-template provides reproducible deploy/build pipeline plus image resize/prune scripts for generated assets.
